SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(AVG(anglers), 1) as avg_anglers,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 92
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 235 AND 250
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
